IEHG-BEAM-M1.description: Inelastic Hinge Property Assignment - Beam (IEHG-BEAM-M1). Assigns a named inelastic hinge property to a beam-type object; the record is keyed by object id and references an existing Inelastic Hinge Property by name.

INEL_PROP_NAME.description: Name of the Inelastic Hinge Property to assign. Must reference an existing Inelastic Hinge Property in the model; the assignment fails with a wrong-data error if no property with this name exists.
